outcome: rates of infants discharged following exclusive breastfeeding
rates of mother-infant pairs starting skin-to-skin contact within one hour after delivery
cohort: The study analyzed database records of mother-infant pairs from the Turkey Health Quality Indicators System (THQIS) between 2021 and 2023.
finding: Digitization in nursing processes and the use of Clinical Decision Support Systems (CDSS) significantly improved safe childbirth checklist usage rates, exclusive breastfeeding rates, and early skin-to-skin contact rates between 2021 and 2023.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between January and May 2024, analyzing records from 2021-2023.
